overview_description.description:
Sleep Reset is a personalized, science-backed sleep program that offers a comprehensive solution for better sleep. Clinically proven to reduce insomnia symptoms, Sleep Reset has shown remarkable results, increasing total sleep time by an average of 85 minutes for individuals with short sleep durations. It also significantly reduces the time it takes to fall asleep and the frequency of nightly awakenings by approximately half.

With Sleep Reset, you'll receive a dedicated sleep coach who tailors the program to your specific needs, addressing the root causes of your sleep issues. This personalized approach ensures long-term effectiveness, providing you with a sustainable solution to improve your sleep within just a few weeks, all without the need for pills or melatonin.

Sleep Reset was developed in collaboration with renowned sleep experts from leading sleep clinics and universities, such as Stanford and Yale. Its credibility is further supported by its recognition in notable publications like Forbes, TechCrunch, and INSIDER. Additionally, Sleep Reset has received backing from prestigious Silicon Valley investors, including YCombinator, Foundation Capital, New Enterprise Associates, Stanford University, and numerous founders and executives from prominent companies.
